verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly touches retention and deletion. The CLI manages sandbox lifecycle and snapshots, sandboxes can be managed programmatically and shut down quickly, and snapshots and volumes are the persistent data stores a user would need to control. None of the evidence documents explicit deletion of sandboxes, snapshots or volumes, nor any retention policy. Missing for 10: documented delete operations for sandboxes, snapshots and volumes; configurable retention or auto-deletion periods; data-deletion guarantees or a retention policy; independent corroboration.
